games.name: Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5
games.desc:
Blackhawk Rescue Mission 5 is a tactical openworld shooter with vast maps and thrilling gameplay. Engage in team-based combat throughout Ronograd Island or rescue survivors in the exciting new ZOMBIES gamemode. Go head to head in PvP or even build out your own Headquarters to boost your income offline.

• Customize your operator with over 1000+ unique outfit combinations.
• Build your dream gun with 70+ choices and over 100 attachments. 
• Purchase and own 20+ vehicles and helicopters from modern militaries. 
• Multiple engaging gamemodes with many hours of fun ahead.
• Make your own custom scenarios and maps with the Sandbox Mode. [Realtime Game Editor]

PC, Console, and Mobile are supported. 
Headphones recommended for best audio experience. All music is non-copyright and streamer safe.

Based on PlatinumFive's original Military RP games.

games.name: 🔪 MAFIA [V2.2.1]
games.desc:
CHAPTER 2: TAR AND ASH, IS OUT NOW!

Somebody at this table is a killer. Good luck figuring out who.

MAFIA is a social deduction game remade around the classic Mafia formula — but when night strikes, the kills happen in first person. Watch the Mafia hunt their target, the Doctor scramble to save them, and the town erupt into chaos when the lights come back on.

Sit at the table. Read the room. Cast your vote. Get it wrong, and the Mafia wins.
16 roles. Multiple maps. No one you can trust.

🔔 Join the group for updates and events!
⚠️ Data doesn't save in private servers!
